_comment: Controlled vocabulary. THE single source of truth — vault/index.html and vault/capture.mjs both read this file. Add tags here; free additions made in the gallery land on entries but are not promoted into this list until you add them deliberately. Hues are low-chroma on purpose (see skills/color-taste): chips are data encoding, not decoration.
_compositionComment: Positive merit tags only — see skills/academic-composition. A tag means the quality is PRESENT and human-approved. Never apply one to record that the quality is missing; compositional failures belong in the note, in prose, until a dedicated issue taxonomy exists.
_dialectsComment: Stored dialects, matching files in dialects/. The normal route to a new one is the distillation evidence rule in vault/README.md — 3+ human-approved out-of-dialect references sharing decision logic, and Alex approves. immersive-authored-world is PROVISIONAL: author-created ahead of evidence, and confirmed only once 3+ human-reviewed entries carry it with dialectStatus 'in'. It is listed here so those human review decisions can be recorded; never assign it automatically. Status is tracked in dialects/README.md.
_dialectStatusComment: unreviewed = not yet judged by a human. in = belongs to a stored dialect. out = good work outside every stored dialect (the raw material for new ones). hybrid = shares decision logic with a stored dialect but diverges in expression.
_risksComment: Named failure modes and near-failures — the ONLY category where a tag records something wrong. Every other category is positive merit. Kept separate so a merit query never returns a risk.
